annotations.title: Where the weather ahead is most dangerous: cities and countries

description:
The cities (of 100,000 or more) or the countries where the next 1 to 7 days' weather is most dangerous, ranked by how high the risk reaches and how many people it reaches: heat, cold, wind, heavy rain, snow and freezing rain.

Use for "where will it be hottest this week", "which European cities face storms in the next two days", "which countries have the most people at high risk". One place: get_forecast; disasters now: list_hazards; countries' long-term risk: rank_countries.
